name: garch-method
description: Volatility forecasting + position sizing via walk-forward GARCH(1,1). Answers 'how much' — never 'which way'. Vol forecasts, storm/calm regimes, vol-targeted sizing, and an honest fixed-vs-vol-targeted backtest harness for any strategy. Local fork of milesdeutscher/garchmethod with refit, data-validation and dependency fixes.
